verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own docs say you can host its APIs in your own environment for data privacy and infrastructure control, run them on GPU-accelerated infrastructure, and deploy them across Kubernetes clusters. The homepage also says it runs on device, on prem and in the cloud. The evidence consists only of short first-party summary lines, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting docs (container images, licensing/access requirements, feature parity with the SaaS), independent or hands-on corroboration of on-prem deployment.
